_comment: Quality benchmark of oml memory recall (oml memory bench --quality, run by tests/memory-check.ps1): invented records of an OutSystems project, and questions in everyday words. expect = the 1-based number of the record that answers it (or a list of them); null = nothing answers it. set = tune (default) or blind. The records are made up: no real tenant data and no secret. Records 1-24 and the tune questions were written before the first run and not tuned afterwards. Records 25-40 and the blind questions were written in one go on 2026-11-01, before any run against them: never change the engine or the weak flag by looking at the blind results.

records.text: Orders_CS stays private; Billing calls it through a service action
records.why: Keeps the order data model hidden from other apps

records.text: The OrderDetail screen is huge; read it with tree --depth 2 first
records.why: A full describe costs too many tokens

records.text: The order total is Subtotal plus Tax minus Discount, rounded to 2 decimals
Invoices are created by a nightly timer, never from a screen
records.why: A screen call timed out on large batches

records.text: Ask the user before making any server action public
records.why: Public actions are a security decision

records.text: REST APIs with Authentication None are fine; Kong handles authentication
Customer email must be unique; the unique index is on Customer.Email
The customer list aggregate is slow without a filter on Active
Stock levels come from the warehouse REST API and are cached for 5 minutes in a site property
The warehouse API answers 429 above 10 calls per second; retry with a delay
Dispatch means the Shipment entity moved to status Sent
The user confirmed that shipping labels are printed in the carrier portal, not in the app
Payment callbacks use the PaymentCallback REST service with an HMAC signature check
Never write card data to the log in the Payments error handler
The monthly report runs on the first day of the month at 02:00 as the Report_Monthly timer
Excel exports use the standard Excel tool, with no custom JavaScript
The roles Admin, Manager and Viewer are static entities; Viewer is the default
The login screen redirects in a loop when the landing screen needs a role
OSUI means OutSystems UI, the shared UI library of all apps
Screen labels are in Portuguese; names in logic are in English
Product images are stored as binary data in ProductImage, at most 2 MB each
Catalog search uses LIKE in SQL; put a wildcard only at the end of the text to stay fast
Audit entries are written by the single service action Audit_Log, called from every module
Added the retry delay to the warehouse stock call; staged Inventory_v3.oml
Order numbers come from the OrderNumber_Next server action, which locks the Counter entity
records.why: Two users got the same number before

records.text: Deleting an order also deletes its OrderLine records through the delete rule Delete; use Protect for invoices
VAT rates live in the static entity TaxRate; Portugal uses 23 percent
The user said credit notes are out of scope for this release
Phone numbers are stored in E.164 format with the country code
Customer addresses are a separate Address entity, one customer to many addresses
Each warehouse has a Code of 3 letters, such as LIS and OPO, used in every stock call
The carrier SOAP service needs the WSDL refreshed after every carrier release; calls fail with a schema error otherwise
Refunds above 500 euros need a second approver with the Manager role
The sales chart freezes the browser above 5000 points; group the data by week first
Sessions expire after 20 minutes of inactivity, set in the module's session timeout
Every new screen uses the LayoutTopMenu layout and the OSUI theme colours
Dates are stored in UTC and shown in the user's time zone with a client action
Product prices are kept in a PriceHistory entity; the current price is the newest row
Audit_Log must not run inside the main transaction; it uses CommitTransaction first so a rollback keeps the entry
Emails are sent through the SendGrid REST connector, from the address no-reply of the company domain
